title: Feedback record
description: One piece of feedback about HITLd, recorded by `hitld feedback` in the consuming project's private store as feedback/FB-<n> (design part 18.4). It holds the person's own words and the project's IDs, so it is confidential and is refused anywhere but the private store. Publishing it is a separate, approved step. A filed record carries the issue's URL in `url`; a withheld one carries the reason in `reason`.

harness.description: The harness and its version. A version the core cannot learn offline is the string "unknown".

area.description: The loop or command concerned, from --area or taken from the refs.

refs.description: Dispatch, decision, item and ledger event IDs the feedback is about.

what_happened.description: A short account drawn from the ledger entries for the refs. Absent when none were found.

expected.description: What the person expected, when they said it.

evidence.description: The ledger entries for the refs, one compact line each.

url.description: The filed issue's URL. Only for filed.

reason.description: Why the record was withheld. Only for withheld.
